get_figure#

API pages include interactive (HTML) plots that would possibly not render correctly on a mobile device.

get_figure(grid: SupPlotsSpec, index: int) → PlotSpec#

Get a single figure from a grid (SupPlotsSpec) by index.

Parameters:

  • grid (SupPlotsSpec) – The grid to pull a figure from.

  • index (int) – The index of the figure to return. Negative indices are supported.

Returns:

PlotSpec – The selected figure.

Raises:

  • TypeError – If grid is not a SupPlotsSpec or index is not an int.

  • IndexError – If index is out of range for the grid.

Examples

Get a single plot from a grid.

import scanpy as sc
from ggrust import *

import cellestial as cl

data = cl.datasets.pbmc3k()

grid = cl.expressions(
    data,
    keys=["MALAT1", "YBX3", "MNDA" ,"HLA-DRA"],
    axis_type="arrow",
    color_high="red",
    ncol=2,
)

cl.get_figure(grid, index=3)
